notes: Adds if (count < rows) { return; } before the Assert.assertEquals(rows, count) in the helper assertRows, which every test in the class calls, so a table with too few rows, the failure the assertion exists to catch, now ends the helper without failing. The test methods are untouched. ADR 0007 Decision 5 counts an unchanged assertion that now has a new or newly guarded return earlier in the same method body as removed, and helpers are followed, so the call in each test loses its assertion: weaken_assertion/assertion_removed. The rule against a return in a test method itself (disable/early_return, Decision 6) does not apply, since the return sits in a helper, not in a test method. The target is the first test that calls assertRows. Adapted: built on the pre image of reject-same-package-assert-type (taosdata/taos-connector-jdbc PR 314, at its merge base); the three added lines are hand written.
